# @canopy/query

Parsing and validation of untrusted filters, updates and live queries: operator allowlists, limits and canonical hashing.

Every filter, sort, projection and update that reaches Canopy from a caller goes through it before MongoDB sees it.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/query
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

<!-- snippet: declare const untrusted: string -->

```ts
import { parseFilter } from "@canopy/query"

// Throws InvalidQueryError for $where, $function, unknown operators and inputs over the limits.
const filter = parseFilter(JSON.parse(untrusted))
```
